title: Must every run of Publish the image refuse an unsigned image, or only the run that hears Image signed?
description: ST-BLD-PO03 says that an unsigned image MUST NOT be published. Today the run that hears Image signed (stego image publish --after) refuses an unsigned image, and a run with --record, --record-sha256 and --build-record publishes a verified image without a signature check, as ST-BLD-UC06-R01 asks. The CI registry check (scripts/check-application-registry.py) and the delivery publication (scripts/application-images.py) use that path, and CI makes no SBOM attestation about an image digest yet. Options: (a) every publication requires the signature flags and a verified signature, and the CI jobs publish only after a sign job makes the SBOM attestations, a workflow change; (b) keep both paths, and state in ST-BLD-UC06-R01 that a publication outside the policy is for a private test registry only; (c) keep both paths without a change. The builder recommends (a), after the workflow change lands.
